publications.name: The Path of Least Resistance: Guiding LLM Reasoning Trajectories with Prefix Consensus
publications.publisher: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
publications.summary: In this work, we propose a training-free drop-in replacement for Self-Consistency decoding that exploits early prefix consensus among LLM reasoning traces, resulting in a reduction in token usage up to 60% while maintaining accuracy.

publications.name: Offloaded Reasoning: Efficient Inference for Large Language Models via Modular Reasoning and Refinement
publications.publisher: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics (EMNLP 2025)
publications.summary: Our work Offloaded Reasoning aims to improve inference efficiency for reasoning capable Large Language Models (LLMs) by proposing a framework for offloading the reasoning component to smaller, lightweight models.
